headers.description: Optional prepaid key. Buy one by card at https://hubvibe-io.com/start ($25, $100 or $500 of credit; the key is shown when the payment clears). Tool discovery is free; all 70+ tools and every price are in https://hubvibe-io.com/openapi.json.
